blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Friday said the filing of a plunder case against Sen. Loren Legarda and her son Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste before the Sandiganbayan is forthcoming. Ombudsman investigators accused the mother and son of allegedly conspiring “to secure exclusive government rights over the country’s solar energy resources through legislative and regulatory actions.” These conspiracy reportedly resulted in more than ₱10.4 billion in unpaid financial obligations to the government. Both Legarga and Leviste denied the accusations. Remulla reiterated that the plunder complaint against Legarda and Leviste is in the preliminary investigation (PI) stage before the […]...
